newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CANAL PLUS BUYS DUTCH SOCCER TV RIGHTS.
newsitem.headline: CANAL PLUS BUYS DUTCH SOCCER TV RIGHTS.

text.p: French pay television group Canal Plus said on Tuesday its Dutch subsidiary was to pay 145 million guilders over the next five years for the rights to show live Dutch first division football matches.
The deal gives Canal Plus the rights to 68 games, or two matches per week, at least one will featuring one of the Dutch league's "big three", Ajax Amsterdam, Feyenoord Rotterdam and PSV Eindhoven.
Matches will be broadcasts in the Netherlands on the subscription channels FilmNet and MultiChoice.
Canal Plus struck the deal with Eredivisie NV, a grouping of all 18 Dutch first division clubs.
Dutch public broadcaster NOS will continue to show match highlights.
